module: "Procedural" framing mode (default mode) of the screenshot creator. From the vehicle's nodes, it computes the camera that makes the vehicle fit in the image with given margins: nodes disabled by the nodeOutpaint module are ignored, those below the ground and automatic mirrors are handled separately, then a bisection search finds the minimum distance along a camera rail. If there is no solution, a fallback position and an optimized rotation are used. Registers via the onScreenshotCreatorCollectFramingModes hook (id "procedural", order 100).
usage:
local res, err = util_screenshotCreator_framing_procedural.resolve({vehicle = veh, resolution = {1280, 720}, fov = 20, useFramingMargins = true})
if not res then log('E', 'framing', err) end
notes: Default values: fov 20°, nearPlane 0.1, resolution {500, 281}, camera height 1.6 m above the ground, axis offset of 0.10 m downward.
Errors returned: non-positive resolution, fov outside ]0,180[, negative nearPlane or non-positive aspectRatio, no framing point above ground.
Zero margins unless context.useFramingMargins (or useMargins) is true; then context.margin or settings.getFramingMargin(resolution) is used. Mirrors have a fixed margin of 2 pixels.
A selfCheck() (assertions) runs only once at the first resolve; a failed assertion would raise a Lua error.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: thumbnailConfig, nodeOutpaint, settings, vehicleSetup (prefix util_screenshotCreator_).

resolve.desc: Computes the procedural framing camera for context.vehicle. Returns {pos, rot, name = "procedural camera", debugData, framingData}, or nil and an error message.

context.desc: vehicle (required), resolution, fov/fieldOfView, nearPlane, aspectRatio, fixedRotation (quat), configName, cameraHeight, cameraAxisDownOffset, useFramingMargins/useMargins, margin ({left,right,top,bottom}).

returns.desc: Framing result (pos: vec3, rot: quat, name, debugData, framingData).

getVehicleFramingData.desc: Prepares the framing data: classifies the vehicle's nodes (enabled, disabled, below ground, mirrors), computes the bounding box, the look-at point, the camera rail and the extreme points used for framing and rotation. Falls back to the corners of the vehicle's box if no node is enabled.

context.desc: Same context as resolve (vehicle, configName, cameraHeight, cameraAxisDownOffset).

returns.desc: "No above-ground framing points" if nothing is usable.

selfCheck.desc: Internal assertion-based test on the selection of rotation nodes (below-ground nodes and mirrors kept, disabled nodes excluded, fallback to backup points). Returns true.

onScreenshotCreatorCollectFramingModes.desc: Hook called by framingManager when collecting modes. Adds {id = "procedural", label = "Procedural", order = 100, supportsFixedRotation = true, resolve}.
